user_query: My company is organizing a music event and we need some inspiration. Can you provide us with the greatest of all time Hot 100 songs chart information? Additionally, we want to create a playlist with the top R&B/Hip-Hop albums. Could you fetch the chart information for those albums as well? Finally, we would like to set up a radio station with songs from these charts. Can you assist us with that?

TaskList.description: Fetch the chart information for the greatest of all time Hot 100 songs.
Fetch the chart information for top R&B/Hip-Hop albums.
Create a playlist with songs from the fetched charts.
Set up a radio station with songs from the created playlist.
